rules.sentence: When `CR-MONTH-WITHDRAWALS` is less than `WS-FREE-WITHDRAWALS` and `CR-STATUS` is `'B'` (`CR-BLOCKED`), it performs `1000-START-CARD-TOTALS`, runs `ADD AO-BALANCE AO-OVERDRAFT-LIMIT GIVING WS-AVAILABLE`, subtracts `AO-HOLDS` from `WS-AVAILABLE`, computes `WS-DAY-CASH` as `CR-DAY-CASH + RQ-AMOUNT`, sets `WS-FEE` to 0, computes `WS-TO-HOLD` as `RQ-AMOUNT + WS-FEE`, sets `RS-RESULT` to `RS-CARD-BLOCKED`, sets `RS-MESSAGE` to `'CARD BLOCKED'`, and returns to its caller.
